content: The execution successfully completed the HWPX template filling task with a perfect reward. Key to this success was the thorough plan involving: 1) Unzipping the HWPX to identify the specific XML files containing placeholders (Contents/section0.xml). 2) Handling the budget normalization (removing commas while retaining the currency symbol). 3) Appending duration spans (e.g., '(3개월)') to project phases. 4) Crucially, removing layout-cache elements (e.g., `<hp:lineSegArray>`) within modified paragraphs to ensure the HWPX renderer recalculates the layout. The script correctly preserved the ZIP structure and namespaces, ensuring a valid output file.
